exercises.why: **охватил** — охвати́ть (perfective): to embrace; to include, to take in. Wiktionary: о- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does о- add in окле́ить?
options: spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists окле́ить under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in уста́вить?
options: settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists уста́вить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cover by gluing (e.g. a wall with wallpaper)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: охвати́ть — to embrace; обхвати́ть — to clasp; окле́ить — to cover by gluing (e.g. a wall with wallpaper); уста́вить — to set (with), to cover (with).
